population.description: Healthy adults undertaking resistance or high-intensity intermittent training

all.label: trains at least twice a week

statement: Creatine monohydrate increases high-intensity exercise capacity and strength gains when combined with resistance training; it is among the most extensively studied ergogenic aids and shows no consistent evidence of harm to kidney or liver function in healthy adults at recommended doses.

citations.title: International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: safety and efficacy of creatine supplementation in exercise, sport, and medicine
citations.source: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition

doseResponse.summary: 3-5 g/day maintenance saturates muscle stores within about four weeks; an optional 20 g/day loading phase for 5-7 days reaches saturation faster but is not required.
